content: Anumaya Koti'a kake hulateseana alakepa au'avate maleno kake hulatekaiye.

Lapa'kaeya mako ve'kae “Kakaeya ina akufa kava ma akufa kava nehane.” nehutapa kake hune'ataya'maki lamake ani hao'otake kava hu'naya yafe vaya'nimokitapa mako'ke mako'ke'mokitapa ani ke ohinina'maki lapa'kaeya kake hupataya vaya'mokitapa ani hao'otake kava nehayana lapa'kaitapi lapa'kufake kake hune'atae.
Lakaeya ako afi'none Anumaya Koti'a alakepa kava huno ani hao'otake kava hu'naya vaya'aina kake hupateteno anona'a apamikefe alakepa kava huno ne'apame.

Anona'a ne'apamiki kakaeya hana kakesa ne'afine? Vaya'nimoka kakaeya ani akufa hao'otake kava nehaya vaya'aife “Kakaeya ina kava nehane. Ma kava nehane.” hu'ka hune'apate'ka kakaeya'ae ani akufa hao'otake kava nehane. Kakaeya inake nehane “Anumaya Koti'a kake hunateteno anona'a'ni o'namike.” hu'kae nehape? He'e hao'otake kava hu'nananakeno anona'a'ka kamike.

Hifi Anumaya Koti'a lusiya huno kanale kava hukateteno makale kake huo'kateno yatala kana kakeva maino ne'eki hao'otake kava hu'nana anona'a'ka makale o'kamino vase huno kakeva mai'nea yafe “Afa yane.” hu'ka kakesa ne'afipi? Kake'atike ke nehanaki hao'otake ya'kae kakesa afite'ka kaipa ai'ka yahae nehu'ka “Mako'ae ohukoe.” hu'ka hisana yafe Anumaya Koti'a kanale kava hukateno kake huo'kate'niki ani yafe o'afi'nape?

Kaipa atafa hu'ka lo'kiya vai'ne'ka “Hao'otake ya'ne afite'na naipa ai'na yahae ohukoe.” hu'ka nehana yafe Anumaya Koti'a kakaeyafe hai vaiteno havi miya'ka kamisea miya ali'ka anupa hu'ka male'nisanakeno'aena Anumaya Koti'a kake hupatesea afina ani miya kamisea miya'mo'a akai'a alakepa huno kake hukatesea ya kavelike.
Anumaya Koti'a mi'ko vaya'moki hu'naya au'ava'apile ne'akeno anona'a miya'api apamike.

Apamikea'maki mako vaya'moki “Anumaya Koti'a amuse huno laki alino asaka nehisiketa lo'kiya hale ya'a'ae maikune.” nehu'a akola maike maike hu apavamu alisaya yafe apayamufa ne'vale'a kanale kava'ake huke huke nehaya vaya'aina Anumaya Koti'a akola maike maike hisaya apavamu apamike.

Apamikea'maki mako vaya'moki apa'kai'api apa'kufae'ke apa'kesa ne'afi'a lamake'ake ke apa'kame'ya ne'ami'a hao'otake au'ava kava hu yatekake a'kame ne'malayanakeno Anumaya Koti'a lusi hai vai ne'apateanakeno apa'kufa apa'kafu kisea miya'api apamike.

Hao'otake kava huke huke nehaya vaya'moki hao'otake kava hu'naya yafe mi'koma'a Anumaya Koti'a lusi kana hapaisea ya'ae apa'kufa lusiya huno apa'kafu kisea ya'ae apa'kaeya alino ati kapatekaiye. Hokoteno Yuta vaya'ai apamiteno henaka'a Yuta nofi o'mai vaya apamike.

Apamisike'a alikaya'maki kanale kava nehaya vaya'aina Anumaya Koti'a ko'ku'nate ano hale lo'kiya ya'a'ae ala apa'ki'ae apaipa falu hapaisea ya'ae apamike. Hokoteno Yuta vaya'ai apamiteno henaka'a Yuta nofi o'mai vaya'ae apamike.
Anumaya Koti'a mi'ko nofi vaya'aina miya apamikefena hai lavi kase lavi huno o'apamikifa mako'ke akufa avamete'ke maleno apamike.

Apamikeanake'a ke male male'nea ke hapa'opaike'a o'afi'nisaya vaya'moki hao'otake kava hu'nisayana Anumaya Koti'a ani ke male male'nea keleti kake huo'apatekaiya'maki kake hupateteno alino fa'ko hinake'a hani aku'ainaka akola apa'kufa apa'kafu kisea no maikae. Maikaya'maki mi'ko vaya'moki Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke'a afi'nisaya vaya'moki hao'otake kava hu'nisayana Anumaya Koti'a akai'a ke male male'nea keleti kake hupateteno alino fa'ko hupatekaiye.

Fa'ko hupatekaiya'maki mako vaya'moki Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke afi'ne'ae'maki a'kame o'malesayana Anumaya Koti'a apa'kaeyafe “Alakepa vaya mai'nae.” huno huo'apatekaiya'maki Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke mi'ko a'kame ne'malesaya vaya'aife Anumaya Koti'a “Alakepa vaya mai'nae.” huno hupatekaiye.

Hupatekaiya'maki Yuta nofi o'mai'naya vaya'moki Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke apa'kaeyapi ohane'nea'maki mako'amoki apa'kai'api apaipa apa'kesafati hane'nea ke a'kame ne'malaya yafe apa'kai'api apaipa apa'kesafati Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke ali'a fole ai'nae.

Fole ai'naya'maki Anumaya Koti'a akai'a ke male male'nea ke apaipafi kano apavelike'a apaipa apa'kesa afi'a alu alu nehu'a mako afina “Hao'otake kava hane.” huno kake hune'apateno mako afina “Kanale kava hane.” huno apave nele. Ani laipafi kamale'nea ya laveli'neanakeno nakaeya Yisasi'a hulate'nea yafe kanale ke hu'noapati inake hukoe “Mako afina ma mopa hano hisea afina Anumaya Koti'a Yisasi Kalaisina hutesikeno mi'ko vaya'moki fala'ki'a nehaya kavafe kake hupatetesikeno Anumaya Koti'a fa'ko huno anona'api apamike.”
Yuta vaya'moki inake nehae “Ke male male'nea kemo'a laya huke.” hu'naya'maki kasuke hu'nae.
Kakaeya inake hu'nane “Yuta ve'ka mai'noanake'na Anumaya Koti mafa'ne mai'ne'na Mosese'a male male'nea ke afi'na a'kame ne'maloanakeno naya huke.” hu'ka kakai'ka kaki ali'ka asaka nehape?
Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke ako ali'a kaya hake'ka afi'nana yafe “Anumaya Koti'a nehaiya kava afite'na alakepa au'ava ya ako afi'noa ve'ka mai'noe.” hu'ka nehape?

Kakaeya make hu'ka kakesa ne'afine “Mi'ko ke male male'nea kemo kanale afi ya'ae lamake ke hu ya'mo aepa'a afi'noanake'na aulaka fali ka'nisikeno no'akesea ve'ka visea ka avelikoe. Hani yapi mai'naya vaya'aina a'na halepatekauve. Mako ya o'afi'nisaya vaya ali'na apaya nehu'na aise aise mafa'neyakatato ali'na apaya hukoe.” hu'ka nehape?
He lamake alu vaya'aina ali'ka apaya nehana'maki na'ya hike'ka kakai'ka ali'ka kaya nohane? “Kumaya ya oheo.” hu'ka hapa'nepaina'maki kakai'ka kumaya ya nehana ve'ka mai'napi o'mai'nane?

“Kumai kavana oheo.” hu'ka vaya hapa'nepaina'maki kakai'ka ani kumai kava nehapi nohane? “Ako fali'naya vaya'aife ‘Anumayati mai'ne.’ hu'a apa'kisana nefaiya kavafe alaki o'nahaiye.” hu'ka nehana'maki ani vaya'ai mono nopati kumaya ya nehapi nohane?
Kakai'ka kaki ali'ka asaka nehu'ka inake nehane “Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke afi'noe.” hu'ka hu'nana'maki ani ke ali'ka ataka'nana yafe Anumaya Koti aki ali'ka haviya hu'napi ohu'nane?
He Anumaya Koti ke kamale'naya avopi Yuta vaya'mokitaena inake hu'a hu'nayane

content.text: “Lapa'kaitapi hao'otake kava nehaya yatapimo'a Yuta nofi o'mai'naya vaya'moki hao'otake yatapi akete'a Anumaya Koti aki ne'a'a kamuke hau'nae.” hu'ne.

content: Apa'koya ano'a laka hu yana afa ya'kana nehe.

Lamake ke male male'nea ke a'kame malesayana “Yuta vaya mai'none.” hu'a hisaya yafe apa'koya ano'a laka hu kava'mo'a lapaya hukea'maki ke male male'nea ke alitapa atakaesayana apa'koya ano'a laka hu ya'mo'a afa ya'kana huke.

Afa ya'kana hukea'maki ani yafe apa'koya ano'a laka nohaya vaya Yuta nofi o'mai vaya'moki Anumaya Koti ke male male'nea ke a'kame malesayana Anumaya Koti'a ani vaya'aife inake huno huke “Nakaeya mafa'ne mai'ne'a apa'koya ano'a laka humale'naya vaya'kana nehae.” huno hupatekaiye.

Lamake ke male male'nea ke avopi kamale'naketapa lapa'koya ano'a laka nehaya'maki ani ke male male'nea ke ali'a ne'atakaya yafe mako apa'koya ano'a laka nohaya vaya Yuta nofi o'mai vaya'moki ke male male'nea ke afi'a a'kame malesayana lapa'kaeya lapa'kase'a kanale kava nehayanake'a lapa'kaeyafe “Hao'otake kava nehae.” hu'a hulapatekae.

Inaki mako ve'kamo'a ameka akufa'aleti'ke “Nakaeya Anumaya Koti vaya'a Yuta ve'ka mai'noe.” huno hisea ve'kamo'a akaeya Yuta ve'ka alaki o'mai'ne. O'mai'nea'maki mako ve'kamo akoya ano'a laka hute'nea'maki ameka akufaleti'ke ani kava hu'nea ve'kamo'a Yuta vaya alaki o'mai'nea'maki Anumaya Kotina aipa alaki ami'nea ve'ka lamake Yuta ve'ka mai'ne. Ani ve'kamo'a ke male male'nea ke a'kame malesea yafe akoyamo ano'a laka ohu'nea'maki Anumaya Koti Fate Akufa Avamu'a eno aipafi mai'neno haekafa aipa aku akesa amikeno mai'ne. Mai'nikeno vaya'moki ani kava hu'nea ve'kamo aki ali'a asaka ohukaya'maki Anumaya Koti'a aki alino asaka huke.
